stem: In a series $LCR$ circuit, the applied voltage leads the current by $60^\circ$. If the resistance is $10\ \Omega$, what is the impedance of the circuit?

verdicts.working: For a series LCR circuit, \(\cos\phi=R/Z\). Thus \(Z=10/\cos60^\circ=20\,\Omega\).

working:
$Z\cos\phi=R$

Independent check: For a series LCR circuit, \(\cos\phi=R/Z\). Thus \(Z=10/\cos60^\circ=20\,\Omega\).
